rules: One feature per session. passes=true only when done_check exits 0. needs_review items also need the owner to set reviewed=true after testing the preview. Only the owner adds or removes features.

features.title: Project skeleton
features.description: Shared blocks package (Section, Heading, Text, Image, Button, Spacer), admin app with the Puck editor, renderer that turns page JSON into static HTML, Rust publish engine writing sitemap.xml and robots.txt, CI workflow.
features.done_check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && npm run publish:local

features.title: Preview deploy via GitHub Actions
features.description: GitHub Actions deploys the admin build (apps/admin/dist) to Cloudflare Pages with wrangler (direct upload) on every push to any branch; main is the production preview. The preview URL is posted as a PR comment and in the job summary. Added by the owner because the Cloudflare GitHub-app connection loops on his phone.
features.done_check: npm run lint:workflows && npm run build, plus a green 'Preview deploy' run on GitHub that deployed and loaded the preview (needs the Cloudflare secrets)
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. every push deploys the builder and the link appears in the PR and in the run summary, as described. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Output validation in the publish engine
features.description: crust-publish fails the publish with a plain-language message when a page has an image without alt text, zero or several h1, skipped heading levels, or a missing title/description.
features.done_check: cargo test -p crust-publish validate && npm run publish:local

features.title: Design tokens and Site settings screen
features.description: Admin screen to edit colours, fonts, spacing scale, radius and max width, with live preview and a contrast warning (WCAG AA) for text/background and primary/onPrimary pairs.
features.done_check: npm test -- tokens settings && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. colours, fonts, spacing, corner radius and page width can all be edited, the preview updates live, and a contrast failure shows up both on the field (linked with aria-describedby) and in a summary with a one-click fix, so this does what it says. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Complete block library v1
features.description: Add Columns (2-4, stack on mobile) and Card blocks; responsive viewports (desktop/tablet/mobile) in the editor.
features.done_check: npm test -- blocks && npm run publish:local
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Columns and Card render correctly and stack on phones, and the editor has all three device widths. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Keyboard-accessible editing
features.description: Every drag action has a keyboard alternative (move block up/down, move into/out of a section), visible focus, and screen-reader labels in the editor.
features.done_check: npm test -- keyboard && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): problem. moving blocks by keyboard works well and is clearly announced, but the left rail's "Blocks / Outline" switch can't be reached with the keyboard at all, so the Outline view is mouse-only. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Save to GitHub
features.description: Cloudflare Pages Function that commits page JSON to content/ using a fine-grained GitHub token stored as a Cloudflare secret. Admin Save button with success/error feedback.
features.done_check: npm test -- save-api && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. saving works and gives clear feedback both ways, but an error looks the same as a success and disappears on its own after 10 seconds. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Page list and create page
features.description: Admin page list (title, URL, last edited), create page with title and URL slug validation, open page in the builder.
features.done_check: npm test -- pages && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. this works as described: title, status, address and last edited are shown, the address is checked as you type, and the new page opens straight in the builder. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Publish workflow
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that renders content, runs crust-publish, and deploys to Cloudflare Pages. Publish button in the admin triggers it and shows status.
features.done_check: npm test -- publish && npm run publish:local
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. publishing starts, shows progress, refreshes by itself and reports Live or Failed. One message goes stale, though. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Accessibility and performance checks in CI
features.description: CI runs axe on every published page (no serious issues) and Lighthouse on the sample page (performance >= 95).
features.done_check: npm run check:a11y && npm run check:perf

features.title: Publish check: Image block without an image URL
features.description: crust-publish stops the publish with a plain-language message when an Image block has no image URL, instead of publishing the editor placeholder. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: cargo test -p crust-publish validate && npm run publish:local

features.title: Button alignment
features.description: Button block gets a Left / Center / Right alignment option so it can sit under centred headings. Existing pages keep left alignment. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- blocks && npm run publish:local
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. does exactly what it says. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Theme presets in Site settings
features.description: Start from a ready-made palette and fonts in Site settings. Applying a preset changes all colours and fonts at once and can be undone in one step; presets are checked for AA contrast. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- presets settings && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. presets apply in one click and undo in one step, but after Undo the keyboard focus is lost. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Click the Site settings preview to jump to a colour
features.description: Clicking an element in the Site settings preview moves focus to the colour field that styles it (pointer shortcut; the form stays the keyboard route). Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- settings && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. it works, but two parts of the page point to the wrong colour. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Rename and delete pages
features.description: From the page list, change a page's address or delete it, each with a confirmation step. A renamed page keeps working at its old address: visitors are sent to the new one (Cloudflare Pages _redirects, from content/redirects.json). The Home page can't be renamed or deleted. Keyboard and screen-reader friendly. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- page-actions save-api && cargo test -p crust-publish && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. renaming and deleting are safe, clear and keyboard-friendly. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Show what is not published yet
features.description: The page list marks pages saved to GitHub since the last successful publish (new or edited), and the Publish panel lists everything waiting to go live, including removed pages and Site settings. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- changes save-api && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. it's always clear what is waiting to go live. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: "Open live site" uses the real site address
features.description: The Publish panel's "Open live site" button opens the address the last successful publish went live at (the Cloudflare Pages address, or site.json's baseUrl once it's a real address), instead of the example placeholder. Before the first publish it explains where the link will appear. Added by the owner (approved Claude's recommendation, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- live-link save-api publish-workflow && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. does what it says. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Update links to a renamed page
features.description: When a page is renamed, Button links on other pages that point to the old address are updated to the new one in the same commit. The rename dialog says how many links will change. The redirect stays for links from outside the site. Added by the owner (approved Claude's recommendation, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- relink page-actions save-api && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. links inside pages are updated as promised, but the header menu, footer links and blog posts are not. They keep the old address and rely on the redirect. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Restore deleted pages
features.description: A "Recently deleted" list under the page list shows pages deleted from GitHub, with a Restore button that brings the page back at its old address (from Git history). Added by the owner (approved Claude's recommendation, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- restore save-api && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. deleted pages come back in one click. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Save browser drafts from the page list
features.description: Pages marked "Draft in this browser" get a "Save to GitHub" button in the page list, so a draft can be saved without opening it in the builder. Added by the owner (approved Claude's recommendation, 2026-10-28).
features.done_check: npm test -- save-draft && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. works, with good wording in both cases. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: One status per page in the page list
features.description: A Status column replaces the "Draft in this browser" / "Not published yet" / "Edited since publish" badges with one plain status per page: Only in this browser, Changes not saved, Saved – not live yet, or Live. The long note above the list becomes one short line. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal from the Impeccable review, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- page-status && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Each page now has one clear status, with an icon shape as well as a word. On phones the table turns into readable cards. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Publish saves waiting browser drafts first
features.description: If pages have changes only in this browser, Publish asks once: save them and publish, publish without them, or cancel. The waiting list and the button count include those drafts. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal from the Impeccable review, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- publish-drafts && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The question does what it says and the wording is clear. One accessibility problem: after the question closes, keyboard focus is lost and lands on the top of the page. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Find and sort pages
features.description: A "Find a page" box filters the page list by title or address, and a sort choice orders it by newest edit (default) or by address. The number of matching pages is announced; no matches shows a clear way back. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal from the Impeccable review, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- find-sort && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. Works as described. Feedback is clear and there is an easy way back from an empty result. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Publish shortcut in the top bar
features.description: The builder and Site settings top bars get a "Publish" link with the number of waiting changes; it opens the page list with focus on the Publish panel. Added by the owner (approved Claude's proposal from the Impeccable review, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- publish-shortcut && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. Works as described, from the keyboard too, and the count matches the page list. That page list count has the double-counting noted under F022. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Section styles
features.description: Sections get YOOtheme-style options: style (Page, Muted, Primary, Dark), background image with a tint for readable text, height (auto, medium, large, full screen), and text that switches light/dark to match. Contrast is checked against the actual background. Older pages keep working through a migration. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 1, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- section-styles && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The published sections look right and stay readable on photos. One builder problem: the section toolbar is wider than the canvas, so it hangs off the right edge. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Layout library
features.description: A library panel in the builder with about 20 designed sections (hero, features, image + text, FAQ, call to action, team, pricing, contact...) and 5 page layouts. Click or press Enter to insert; everything uses the site style, so it matches automatically. Each layout passes the accessibility check. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 1, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- layout-library && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Easy to use from the keyboard. Every layout passes the checks and matches the site style. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: My layouts
features.description: Save any section (or a whole page) as your own layout. Saved to GitHub under content/layouts/, shown in the library under My layouts, with rename and delete. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 1, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- my-layouts && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Works as described, and it is clear that layouts are copies. One small wording mistake. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Style customizer v2
features.description: Site settings grow into a full style customizer: type scale, heading weight and letter spacing, button shape and fill, card style (flat, outline, shadow), link style. 8 to 10 complete style presets. Every combination keeps passing the contrast checks. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 2, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- tokens presets customizer && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Full and well explained. The live preview makes choices easy to judge. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Per-device columns
features.description: Columns get widths per device (for example 2/3 + 1/3 on desktop, stacked on phone) and any block can be hidden on phone, tablet or desktop. Works in the canvas preview and on the published site with no JavaScript. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 2, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- responsive && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Works in the published site without JavaScript, as promised. One problem in the phone preview of the builder. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Content, Style and Advanced tabs
features.description: The settings panel splits every block's options into Content, Style and Advanced tabs, so simple edits stay simple. Advanced holds spacing, visibility and an anchor name for links. Full keyboard support. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 2, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- settings-tabs && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Clear split, and simple edits stay simple. Two details are inconsistent. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Header, footer and menu
features.description: A site-wide header (logo, menu built from your pages, call-to-action button, sticky option, phone menu that works without JavaScript) and footer (columns of links, text, copyright). Edited once in Site settings, shown on every page. Stored in site.json with a migration. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 3, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- header footer && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. Works without JavaScript and from the keyboard. The automatic menu takes the first 6 pages, which is sensible. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: More elements
features.description: New blocks: Grid of cards, Gallery, Accordion/FAQ, Icon list, Logo row, Quote/testimonial, and Image overlay (text on an image). All work without JavaScript and pass the accessibility check. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 3, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- blocks && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. All 7 blocks work without JavaScript and are keyboard-friendly. One layout trap: a block added with nothing selected lands at the very end of the page, outside any section. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Theme pack export and import
features.description: Export your style, header/footer style and My layouts as one .crust file; import one into another Crust site with a preview first. Only Crust data, never code or raw HTML, and it's checked (format and contrast) before anything changes. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 2 step 3, 2026-10-29).
features.done_check: npm test -- theme-pack && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Safe and clear. Nothing changes until you confirm. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Media library and image uploads
features.description: Upload images from the Mac or phone into a media library (Cloudflare R2, free tier), pick them from a grid in every image field, with alt text asked for at upload. The publish step makes resized copies (srcset) so pages stay fast on phones. Image URLs keep working. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- media && npm run build && cargo test && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Works well, with one bug. On a block you have just added, picking a library photo does not copy its description into the alt field. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Blog and collections
features.description: A Posts collection: list of posts with date, summary and cover image, a post template built from blocks, an index page and an RSS feed. Posts are content/posts/*.json, published like pages. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- posts && npm run build && cargo test && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The published blog and feed work well. The admin list is plainer than the page list, and its links look like default browser links. Found later while checking the templates: post body text sits against the screen edge (proposal 3). Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Search and sharing settings per page
features.description: Per page: search title, social image, a preview of how the link looks when shared, and a 'hide from search engines' switch. Published as meta tags (Open Graph), and noindex pages leave the sitemap. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- seo && npm run build && cargo test
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass. Works as described, and the share preview is a nice touch. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Contact form block
features.description: A Contact form block (name, email, message, optional fields) posting to a Cloudflare Worker with Turnstile spam protection; messages are emailed to the owner. Clear, accessible errors and a thank-you message; works without JavaScript except Turnstile. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- contact-form && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The form is well built (real labels, autocomplete, honeypot, origin check, a thank-you and an error message that work without script). But when sending fails, the visitor is sent back to an empty form and loses what they typed. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Phone quick-edit mode
features.description: On a phone, the builder opens a simplified editor: change text, swap images and button labels on a page, then save and publish. No layout editing. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- quick-edit && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. It does what it says: one calm form per block, a sticky Save button, clear "saved in this browser" feedback. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Site search
features.description: Search for the published site with Pagefind, built at publish time, no server. A search page and an optional search link in the header; keyboard and screen-reader friendly. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 3, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- search && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Search works and reads well: a labelled field, a results count in a live region, the tab title updates, and there is a no-script message. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Builder tidy-up
features.description: A Sign out item in the builder's top bar; fix the 4 axe issues in Puck's own builder chrome (canvas iframe title, zoom menu label, low-contrast block-list headings, spinner label); bring a renamed page's old-address redirect back when the page is restored. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 4, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- tidy-up && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. All four Puck accessibility issues are gone. Sign out is easy to find, a little too easy. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Layouts for the new blocks
features.description: FAQ, gallery, logo strip, features grid, testimonial and contact layouts in the Layout library, built from the Milestone 2-3 blocks; each passes the layout accessibility check. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 4, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- layouts && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. All the promised layouts are there with plain names and one-line descriptions. The Gallery and Logo thumbnails are hard to judge because they show empty grey boxes. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Rich text in Text blocks
features.description: Bold, italic, links, bulleted and numbered lists inside a Text block, with a small toolbar and keyboard shortcuts. Saved as structured text, never raw HTML; links checked with safeUrl. Migration turns existing plain text into the new format. Free editor only (Lexical or Puck's free rich text field). Design snapshot first. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 4, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- rich-text && npm run typecheck && npm run build && cargo test && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Formatting, links, lists and shortcuts all work. A bad link is refused with a clear message, and focus stays in the field (`aria-invalid` is set). Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Linked sections
features.description: A section saved once and shown on many pages; editing it once updates every page that uses it. Unlinking turns it back into a normal copy. Page-format change with a migration and a DECISIONS.md entry. Design snapshot first. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 4, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- linked-sections && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The idea is clear and the wording is good ("Edit opens it on its own… Unlink makes this page's copy a normal section"). But naming a new linked section makes the page jump sideways and stay there. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Custom domain
features.description: A Site settings field for the site's own address, used by the sitemap, canonical and sharing links, RSS and the 'Open live site' link, plus a step-by-step guide (docs/setup-custom-domain.md) for connecting a domain in Cloudflare. Buying the domain is the owner's step (BLOCKED.md). Added by the owner (approved Milestone 4, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- custom-domain && npm run build && cargo test
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. A very clear screen: the `https://` prefix is built in, there is a live example of the result, the steps are numbered, and it lists where the address is used. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Save a site as a template
features.description: Site settings → 'Save as template' downloads one .crust file with the whole site: design tokens, header and footer, pages, linked sections, saved layouts, a sample post and the photos. Builds on the theme pack file (F033) with kind 'template'; reading it checks everything and drops unknown fields. New file format: spec entry and DECISIONS.md entry. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 5, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- template-file && npm run typecheck && npm run build
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Works end to end, with good wording. Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Placeholder content
features.description: Text and photos in a template can be marked 'replace me'. The builder outlines them and shows a checklist of what's left; publishing stops with a plain-language list while any remain. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 5, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- placeholders && npm run build && cargo test
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. Clear and reassuring ("Publishing waits until each is replaced… or kept on purpose"). Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Template quality check
features.description: One command (npm run check:template) and a CI job that a template must pass: axe at three widths on every page, contrast in every section style, one h1 and heading order, alt text, Lighthouse >= 95 on the home page, every layout renders, no leftover placeholders. Writes a readable report page. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 5, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- template-check && npm run check:template
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): pass with notes. The check does its job and the report is easy to read. But it is blind to layout bugs: it passed all three templates with a visibly broken post page and the oversized preview hero (F048). Fixes: DECISIONS.md, Proposals, 'From the review'.

features.title: Start from a template
features.description: Pages screen → 'Start from a template' opens a gallery: thumbnail, page list and a live preview at desktop, tablet and phone widths. Applying asks first and says exactly what it replaces; the previous site stays in Git history and can be restored. Design snapshot first. Added by the owner (approved Milestone 5, 2026-10-30).
features.done_check: npm test -- start-from-template && npm run build && npm run check:a11y
features.review_note: Reviewed by Claude at the owner's request (2026-10-31): problem. The flow and wording are excellent (a "Replaced / Kept" list, a safe default, a way back). But the live preview of Harbour, the flagship, shows only a blank sky: its opening section grows to 2244 px tall in the desktop preview and 5185 px in the phone preview.
